**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, which flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true` at `02:13:41Z`. Each request then grabbed its own connection from a pool of 20.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, still failing at the end. 530 of 636 requests got 503s, or 83%.

Two things the note flags. `/health` stayed 200 the whole outage. And this log is `node-3 of 3`, so check the other two nodes.

Next: set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`.
